summary: Establish the immutable exact FX rate/provider/policy foundation without enabling conversion, and extend append-only architecture evidence so the mandatory later 089b stage can receive fresh protected-path review without mutating ARCH-089.

impacts.evidence: Stage 089a defines immutable market/reference rate facts and policies only; it adds no tenant-scoped persistence or authority. Future finance records retain tenant ownership independently and 089b must review storage visibility explicitly.

Rate facts, lookup requests and policy/snapshot provenance contain currencies, exact rates, source identifiers and timestamps but no customer PII. Source references are bounded opaque identifiers and cannot contain query strings or credential-shaped material.
Four additive Draft 2020-12 FX v1 contracts are introduced. Existing fx/rate.schema.json and the existing OpenAPI /fx/rates placeholder are not changed, preserving Task-024 compatibility.

An additive finance.fx_rate.published.v2 payload is registered with immutable fact identity/source/effective-time provenance. Existing finance.fx_rate.published.v1 remains byte-for-byte unchanged and stage 089a does not publish either event.

Connector SDK v1 root interfaces and fx.rates.read capability remain unchanged. The new Provider port is a host-side FX capability; reference/provider adapters remain deferred to 089b and must still use Connector SDK/conformance where applicable.
Stage 089a intentionally adds no FX table, cache, SQL migration or backfill. Immutable storage and historical queries are explicitly deferred to stage 089b after Tasks 049, 058 and 059.

Cross-currency conversion stays fail-closed, provider results are host-validated against explicit pair/type/as-of/source, rate source references are opaque non-secret identifiers, and no provider credential/network adapter is added.

The foundation deliberately exposes no conversion operation, preventing sensitive derived financial writes before Task 017 approval and later finance dependencies. Rounding and triangulation are explicit policy rather than implicit defaults.

The conversion snapshot contract requires original/result Money plus complete ordered immutable rate facts, source/reference, rounding/triangulation policy, target minor-unit scale and UTC derivation time so future financial lineage is reproducible.

Source precedence is deterministic and exact-pair only, with explicit missing-rate failure. Staleness windows, cache behavior, persisted source reconciliation and arithmetic verification remain 089b responsibilities.
No webhook, HTTP transport, external egress implementation or provider adapter is added in 089a.
The provider port and normalized missing/mismatch errors create deterministic observability boundaries, but cache/provider latency/staleness metrics remain deferred to 089b.
Rollback removes only additive Go/contracts/docs/governance support; there is no FX persisted state or data migration to unwind. Existing v1 FX contracts remain available.

Unit tests cover exact decimal wire form, immutable fact validation, source precedence, provider-result binding, direct/single-pivot route planning, provenance snapshots, UTC behavior and the conversion-disabled gate; architecture tests cover supplemental staged review admission.
